entities.name: Csaba Kovács
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Csaba Kovacs is a Hungarian professional ice hockey player who is currently playing with Újpesti TE of the Erste Liga. He previously spent the entirety of his career with Alba Volán Székesfehérvár who competed in the Austrian Hockey League (EBEL) before joining MAC Budapest in 2016.
